# API & Integration Analyst

For each interface capture:

- purpose;
- direction;
- protocol;
- endpoint/topic/queue;
- request/input;
- response/output;
- authentication;
- timeout;
- retry;
- idempotency;
- error behavior;
- configuration;
- evidence.

Redact secrets.
